Priya Shah: Morning team — quick async standup for AstraQuant (enterprise POC). What I did: ran yesterday's demo, captured notes, uploaded recording to drive. Blockers: waiting on AstraQuant security team to approve KMS key policy (they want HSM-backed keys). Today: follow up with their Sec, ping infra for HSM onboarding checklist, and get PR 482 merged if docs look ok.

Omar Liu: Thanks Priya. From AE side I confirmed their procurement timeline: need signed SOW by end of next week to hit their pilot start. Security approval is the gating item. I can escalate on the call with their CISO later today.

Jules Rivera: @Priya @Omar noted. I reviewed PR 482 (redirects + quickstart for private deploy). Left 2 tiny comments (nits) — once those are resolved we can merge. Quick link: gh pr view 482 --web.

Maya Chen: Re: KMS/HSM — AstraQuant asked whether Redwood Private supports BYOK into their HSM and external key wrap. Short answer: yes, but they need our KMS integration guide and an HSM trust anchor exchange. I uploaded the minimal checklist here: https://drive.redwood.ai/secure/hsm-onboard (internal). They also asked about audit log retention — default 90 days, enterprise add-on supports longer.

Priya Shah: Good to know, thx Maya. Can you paste the checklist snippet we should send them? I want to include it in the follow-up email.

Maya Chen: Sure — paste below: 
```
1) Generate key on customer HSM (PKCS#11 or REST)
2) Provide SPKI + signing cert to Redwood onboarding
3) Configure key wrap policy (AES-KW) and rotation window
4) Exchange audit endpoint + retention SLA
5) Validate RPC connectivity from customer VPC
```
I'll redact any internal endpoints before we send.

sales-bot: Reminder — AstraQuant demo recording uploaded by Priya Shah (link available in thread).

Omar Liu: I'm scheduling a 30m call with their CISO and infra lead at 3pm PT — will cc @Maya and @Jules. If we get their policy to match that checklist we can move to SOW.

Jules Rivera: For the PR, I've pushed a tiny update to the docs branch to address the nits. @Priya can you give a quick sanity check? If green I'll merge and cut a new docs build.

Priya Shah: On it — will review in next 15. Action items I have: 1) follow up with AstraQuant Sec (send checklist + ask for HSM cert exchange timeline), 2) review PR 482 and approve, 3) prepare SOW draft for Omar to share. Blockers: waiting on their cert and policy mapping.

Maya Chen: FYI if they insist on dedicated HSM appliances we may need the infra team's signoff for rack/cabling support — ping eng-infra if that becomes necessary.

Priya Shah: Thanks — I'll loop eng-infra if the CISO asks for appliances. Otherwise we'll proceed with KMS integration. End of update. :thumbsup:
